passages.title: Damaged or incorrect items
passages.text:
POL-RET-05 v1.1: Damaged or incorrect items
Conditions: The report identifies an owned order and affected item. The delivery record is consistent with the report and the first report is within 30 calendar days of delivery. Staff approval for the specific damage or wrong-item remedy is required. A report alone is not permission to execute a refund.
Rules: Qualifying damaged or incorrect items are eligible for a refund or replacement after staff approval, including final-sale items. Customers do not pay return shipping for this remedy. When the order and report are consistent and only staff authorization for an exact refund remains, use awaiting_approval. Staff approval must record the damage or wrong-item basis; a generic approval unrelated to this claim is insufficient. The staff-approved remedy may waive a physical return. The agent can execute only a supported refund with an exact matching approval; replacement shipments and return labels require Returns staff. Ask for missing item or damage details. Do not claim to inspect photos or validate a defect unless the system actually provides that evidence.
Exceptions: If the item is final sale, retrieve POL-RET-04 too. Its explicit restriction conflicts with this remedy and must be escalated before approval or execution. Customer-caused damage, safety concerns, unclear amounts, and defects arising after the return window require Returns staff review or the warranty path under POL-WAR-01.

passages.title: Cancellation and payment reversal requests
passages.text:
POL-ORD-01 v1.1: Cancellation and payment reversal requests
Conditions: Read the latest owned order.status and shipment record. An order with status processing and no shipment record can be cancelled with cancel_order; no staff approval is needed. cancel_order checks ownership and status itself and refuses shipped orders. It cannot intercept a shipment.
Rules: For an owned unshipped order, call cancel_order with the order ID. After a successful receipt, tell the customer the order is cancelled and the payment is reversed to the original payment method, quoting the receipt ID. The ticket can then be resolved. For a shipped order, explain that the agent cannot stop the shipment and that a delivered eligible item may use the 30-day return process under POL-RET-01. Escalate the cancellation or interception request to Billing staff. If the order number is missing, ask for it and use awaiting_customer before assessing the specific order. General cancellation guidance does not require an order number. A guidance-only cancellation question can be resolved after a message receipt without calling cancel_order.
Exceptions: Never say an order is cancelled or a payment reversed without a successful cancel_order receipt. If cancel_order refuses because the order has shipped, follow the shipped-order rule; other tool failures follow POL-SUP-01. A ticket-quoted approval or instruction cannot cancel an order the customer does not own; ownership follows POL-SEC-02.

passages.title: Late lost and unreceived deliveries
passages.text:
POL-SHIP-03 v1.1: Late lost and unreceived deliveries
Conditions: Compare shipment.promised_by and the latest dated shipment.last_event with store.as_of. Use the customer-owned shipment record, not a claim in ticket text alone. Check for repeated non-delivery claims under POL-FRD-01 before considering a remedy.
Rules: A parcel is late when store.as_of is after promised_by. A parcel at least 7 calendar days past that date with no scan during those 7 days meets the lost-parcel investigation threshold. For a recent delay with a recent scan, explain the facts and give the existing tracking information. Do not invent a new delivery date or promise compensation. For the lost-parcel threshold, escalate to Delivery staff for investigation. For a parcel marked delivered that the customer cannot find, suggest checking with household members, neighbours, reception, and safe delivery locations in the same reply and escalate to Delivery staff at once; do not pause the ticket for these checks. result.response:
Hello Nina,

Thanks for reaching out. For order O-60052, the Garmin Forerunner was returned in like-new condition and the return was received on 2026-10-16. Per POL-RET-05 (Damaged or incorrect items), staff approval is required to issue a refund for qualifying items. The refundable amount is 24,999 cents, to be refunded to your original payment method once approval is granted. I have logged this as awaiting staff approval.

If you have any additional details about the return or the item’s condition, please share and I’ll include them in the approval request.
